source: Original procedural full drums+harmony mix, fixed0.35sum plus0.0001 DC bias to avoid all-silent analysis windows; both decks use the identical loop and start together. Timing stress only.
events: Original #95 hybrid track-gain, crossfader and live recording event order; deck jog/pitch sweeps omitted so both declared ratios and search hops stay fixed.
deadline_rule: D=floor(frames*1000000000/sample_rate). Reuse #95 ceilings: callback wall p99<=D,max<=2D,p99-p50<=floor(D/2); render CPU p99<=floor(3D/4). Full callback thread CPU also uses the same stronger p99 ceiling. Actual >D counts remain separate diagnostics.
scope: Actual offline OutputCallback with simultaneous stereo keylock searches, dense synthesis/effects, control admission and live MIDI note capture. No physical audio driver, hardware deadline, output latency, XRUN or listening-quality qualification. Timings include Rust allocator instrumentation; full CPU also includes wrapper clock overhead. All decode/preparation/report I/O is outside measured callbacks.
